items.headline: Winter Camp: Sign Up Now
items.body: Elite FC Winter Camp runs December 27–31, 9:30 a.m. to 2 p.m., and it's open to all levels. Call it a tune-up for the second half of the season: footwork, technical and tactical drills, strength and conditioning, and creative games. It's also a good excuse to escape visiting relatives for a few hours. The club asks campers to register as soon as possible. Cost: [NEED: price]. To sign up: [NEED: sign-up method/link].
